instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The user requested 'ligit mode only all and admin panel ka bhi same light kro'. You MUST override the existing dark theme (#070b15) in index.css and App.css.
Change the html and body background to a clean, crisp light color (e.g., #F8FAFC or #FFFFFF).
Change the default text color to a highly readable dark slate (#0F172A).
Ensure both the Customer storefront AND the Admin Dashboard use this new light-mode aesthetic.
Preserve all functionalities (checkout, auctions, QC report, Razorpay, etc.), only alter the visual presentation, spacing, layout, and colors.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for headers, dropdowns, or overlays. Always use solid white or glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md).
Replace dark mode classes (like text-gray-400, bg-gray-900) with their light mode equivalents (text-slate-600, bg-white, border-slate-200).

scales.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900

brand_accents.primary: #2563EB (blue-600) for main CTAs, links, active states

marketplace_structure: Trust Strip (Top): Very thin (h-8), bg-slate-900 text-white, showing 'Free Shipping | Quality Guarantee | Secure Checkout'.
Main Header: Sticky top-0, z-50, bg-white border-b border-slate-200. Must contain Logo, large Search Bar (rounded-full bg-slate-100), and Utility icons (Account, Cart, Wishlist).
Category Nav: Below header, bg-white border-b border-slate-200, horizontal scrollable list of categories (Mobiles, Laptops, Accessories, Auctions).
Hero Section: Asymmetric grid (e.g., grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 p-4 lg:p-6). Main banner spans 2 columns, side stack has 2 smaller promo banners.
Product Rails: Section title with 'View All' link. Horizontal scroll on mobile, grid on desktop (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5).
Admin Panel: Sidebar navigation (bg-white border-r border-slate-200). Main content area (bg-slate-50). Dense data tables with white backgrounds and sharp borders.

product_cards.image_container: bg-slate-50 p-4 flex justify-center items-center aspect-square

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700 rounded-lg font-semibold px-4 py-2 transition-colors
buttons.outline: border border-slate-300 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-slate-900 rounded-lg px-4 py-2

badges.auction: bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded
badges.discount: bg-red-100 text-red-700 text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded
badges.qc_passed: bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded

motion.hover: Subtle transform (-translate-y-1) for product cards and tiles.
motion.buttons: Active state scale-95 for tactile feedback.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets minimum 4.5:1 against backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-btn').

visual_enhancers.borders: Use strict 1px borders everywhere to create a clean, dense, structured look (border-slate-200).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal default shadows. Use shadows only for hover states or floating elements like modals/dropdowns (shadow-xl).
visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react with a stroke-width of 1.5 for a clean, modern look.

image_urls.description: Two cell phones side by side on a white surface, great for hero or main promo.
Group of modern cell phones in different colors.
MacBook Pro on a wooden table, clean look.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this by ensuring the light mode looks highly polished, structured, and premium.
Dark colors are BANNED for backgrounds, except for the very top trust strip.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp borders.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md) for sticky headers.
NEVER use generic placeholder text for missing data; always style the empty states elegantly.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, scale effects.
Always use modern button styles, slightly rounded (rounded-lg or rounded-xl) with hover color changes.
